e: E is the fifth letter of the alphabet, and is the most common vowel and letter used in the English language.
The constant e is a real number that has formula \mathrm{e}=\lim_{n \to \infty}\left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)^{n}, and is approximately 2.718281828.
e-mail: E-mail is a system where people can send a message from one computer to another/some others.
I have a new e-mail in my inbox.
An e-mail is a mail sent through such system.
